verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists native HubSpot and Salesforce integrations, which is the product's own CRM connector for this story. Nothing in the pack says what those integrations do: there is no confirmation that calls and texts are logged automatically or matched to the correct CRM contact. The webhooks, API and MCP server are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation that calls and texts auto-log to the CRM, contact-matching behavior, setup or sync details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts log to my CRM automatically against the right contact
